notes.title: Steam Cloud Update
notes.content:
When the game comes out, you will have the possibility to play on different computers with the same save.

The game should be coming at the end of the month or at the start of July.

I also added the possibility to change the wheel color: black and white only.

 Have a nice day! :)

 - TOUQUI

notes.title: Version 0.9
notes.content:
I just finished making some small adjustments. The game is now entering its final phase. I need to test it a bit more and finish preparing the SteamWorks requirements. After that, the game will finally be available for sale at $0.99 USD. Don't expect too much from this game—it's just a simple drift game like the ones that were available online in 2008. Have a nice day!

- TOUQUI
